title: Agent-native SMS / phone
human_answer_md:
Agents often need a phone number that can send SMS — for verification flows, notifications, or two-way messaging. An Agentypical path would let the agent enrol, receive a number under a capped entitlement, send/receive with evidence, and escalate to a human only for spend or KYC that truly requires it.

**Honest status:** no SMS provider is listed as Certified on Agentypical yet. Do not assume a directory hit.
